authority.task: The user supplied a local application repository and requested one verifiable manual-attribution requirement.
authority.implementation: The user subsequently authorized result-page explanations and local acceptance while keeping existing thresholds and calibration, without a Git commit.
authority.framework_record: The user then selected recording the real pilot and forming the RD method-adoption conclusion.
authority.pending: Formal product baselining, priority, and business acceptance are not established by these authorizations.

source_records.scope: One requirement with five acceptance rows and dated implementation/verification status.
Frozen method inputs, both first attempts, offline observations, initial draft, source review, repairs, and focused rereview.
Authorized code changes, HTTP and browser observations, guidance screenshots, reproduction details, setup diagnostics, and cleanup.

provenance.identity_check: All three artifact hashes were recomputed; the current requirement, both changed scripts, and all protected source/data hashes match the acceptance record.
provenance.public_scope: Project identity and machine paths are omitted. Original sources and full records remain in the user-owned project. This summary is not a self-contained, independently reproducible public benchmark; hashes identify artifacts but do not prove their correctness.
provenance.followup_scope: This framework update rechecked the recorded evidence and current file identities. It did not rerun the application or the model comparison.

method_comparison.baseline: Supplied current Chinese rd-requirement instructions and the same frozen project sources.
method_comparison.candidate: The baseline plus optional source-grounded normal, counterexample, and boundary scenarios for a material ambiguity, with no invented obligation or reward for more text.
method_comparison.sampling: One scheduled first response per arm; no retry or replacement response.
method_comparison.quality_comparison: Unavailable: neither arm produced a completed requirement.
method_comparison.execution_boundary: Supplied-text comparison, not native Skill-selection proof. Shared host/system/provider context and order/runtime effects remain; backend identity is not independently attested. Timeouts do not establish method inferiority or explain their own cause.
method_comparison.authoring_separation: The main agent independently produced the delivered requirement. The source-review agent did not read the frozen candidate method or attempted responder outputs. The completed artifact is not attributed to either comparison arm.

real_delivery.verified_behavior: Three challenge slots permit one, two, or three valid responses; only accepted responses contribute. Zero accepted responses produce an error and hide stale results.
real_delivery.boundary_rule: For the actual target count N_i, use L_i = max(80, ceil(0.55 * N_i)). The local generator selects distinct counts from 292 through 332. Fixed N=300 applies only to the offline scoring fixture.

initial_review.reviewer: A separate read-only agent checking the requirement and actual sources; not an external human review.

findings.problem: Fixed N=300 scoring examples were not mapped to actual page-generated counts.
findings.repair: Page acceptance now derives each threshold from its actual N_i; fixed-count function fixtures are explicitly scoped.

findings.problem: Per-response diagnostics and evidence obligations did not clearly distinguish success from the all-invalid failure.
findings.repair: Diagnostics apply to successful results; the all-invalid case records inputs, thresholds, error, and hidden state, with probability/calibration fields not applicable.

initial_review.focused_rereview: Passed with no remaining finding in the repair scope; this was a document-quality verdict before the later implementation.

implementation_followup.observed_gap: The proposed result explanation needed to make uniform prior and the absence of identity proof explicit.
implementation_followup.change: One explanatory paragraph in each of the local and static result pages; existing scoring, thresholds, calibration, and data unchanged.
implementation_followup.validation: The explanation was subsequently observed in both local browser flows, including recovery after an all-invalid input.
implementation_followup.remaining_authority: Local functional checks are complete; formal product priority/baselining and human business acceptance remain open.

adoption.retain: Keep this worked example and use source-grounded normal, exception, and boundary examples when they resolve a material requirement ambiguity.
adoption.observed_value: Two source-verified acceptance ambiguities were repaired and the resulting local behavior was exercised. This demonstrates completion of this case, without causal attribution to the extra candidate method.
adoption.existing_contract: Current rd-requirement step 4 already requires material normal/exception/boundary coverage; step 6 requires scoped convergence.
adoption.default_skill_changes: None: bodies, routing, metadata, adapters, references, and eval definitions remain unchanged.
adoption.optional_future_trial: A reversible, bounded real task with a clear value hypothesis can try the method without requiring the current baseline to fail first. Check that the execution path can complete before another comparison.
adoption.broader_adoption_evidence: Representative usable outcomes and acceptable total effort; comparable inputs and retained first attempts are additionally required if claiming comparative benefit. Question counts, document length, model agreement, or local application test counts are not method-benefit evidence.
